issues.name: Transportation Funding
issues.hook: The 2026 short session moved the referendum on transportation tax increases and closed a nearly $300 million ODOT shortfall.
sources: The 2026 legislative session is nearly over (KATU)

issues.name: Housing and Land Use
issues.hook: Governor Kotek’s priority bills sped affordable housing for seniors and manufactured homes and eased urban growth boundary expansion.
sources: Governor Kotek highlights major wins for Oregonians in 2026 legislative session

issues.name: Taxes and the Budget
issues.hook: The 2026 short session opened under a budget shortfall, and one passed bill raises the statewide lodging tax.
sources: On eve of Oregon legislature’s short session, budget crisis and transportation funding top agenda (KTVZ)
